info.name: TestTrack API Documentation
info.description: TestTrack API for managing tests, questions, and user submissions.

item.name: Endpoints
Handle an incoming authentication request.
Handle an incoming registration request.
Destroy an authenticated session.

Login, register and logout work with Breeze. Breeze is for web requests by default, not api
requests. So, we needed to add the API routes for login, register and logout here.

request.description:
TestResource is for single resources. TestResource::collection(), returns an
AnonymousResourceCollection — which is the collection wrapper that handles pagination,
metadata, and multiple items.
This is an example of the GET request:
/api/tests?page=1&per_page=2&search=&sort_by=title&sort_order=asc
